paragraphs.source_en: Standing aboard the boat, Nene gazed without blinking at the capital as it slowly receded into the distance. She was not a woman who submitted in all things; she and her husband had always stood as equals. What, in the end, was Chacha’s purpose? I shall watch quietly from Osaka Castle… The thorn of life had brought immense pain, and Nene had no choice but to struggle against it.
